senses.zh_definition: 迈阿密：美国佛罗里达州的一座城市；此处作为地名专有名词使用。
senses.en_definition: Miami, a city in Florida, United States.
senses.ms_definition: Nama khas sebuah bandar di negeri Florida, Amerika Syarikat.
senses.nuances: 这是专名释义，并非已核实的 DBP 马来语普通词条，因此不标为 official。缺少原始语境，不能排除同名机构、球队或其他地名。以下搭配是自然的马来语组合，未核定其语料频率。城市身份及名称背景可参见 [Miami 市政府历史资料](https://archive.miami.gov/budget/docs/FY26/FY%202025-26%20Proposed%20Operating%20Budget.pdf)。

etymology.historical_story: Miami carries a place-name history from Florida rather than a Malay word-formation history. Municipal accounts associate its name with Mayaimi and the idea of large waters, recalling the waterways central to the region's earlier inhabitants. In Malay reporting, the name is retained as Miami. Its appearance in Malay text therefore does not establish it as an ordinary Malay vocabulary item. [Source: Miami municipal history](https://archive.miami.gov/budget/docs/FY26/FY%202025-26%20Proposed%20Operating%20Budget.pdf).
